title: Convert Compose Execution to Unit-Owned Renderer/Executor Flow
observed_behavior: Compose desired-state apply already rendered a full project and avoided service-scoped up in the desired-state path.
Validation was performed by ComposeStagingManager instead of the ComposeExecutor control seam.
Compose rendering consumed the environment plan directly, so multi-unit plans could render services outside the target deployment unit.
intended_behavior: Compose desired-state apply selects the target deployment unit and renders only that unit-owned full Compose project into the runtime compose_dir.
The compose_dir ownership gate runs before staging, validation, promotion, or apply for the unit-owned directory.
The CLI executor handles staged validation and full-project apply through the ComposeExecutor/RuntimeControlClient seam.
Desired-state apply does not use service image environment substitution, service-scoped up, or unconditional force recreate.
